dc_title_s: Aerial Imagery for Sheboygan County, WI 2022
dc_description_s: This project established digital, 3-band orthoimagery for Sheboygan County, WI. Aerial imagery was collected on April 10, April 23, May 7, and May 9 using a Vexcel UltraCam M3 sensor mounted in a fixed-wing aircraft. Aerial imagery was collected to support 0.25 and 0.5 foot ground sample distance (GSD) orthoimagery to meet ASPRS Class II horizontal accuracy specifications at 1 inch = 50 feet and 100 feet map scale. The 6-inch pixel orthoimagery was produced to meet or exceed a horizontal accuracy of 1.4 feet RMSE according to ASPRS Positional Accuracy Standards for Digital Geospatial Data. The 3-inch pixel orthoimagery was produced to meet or exceed a horizontal accuracy of .7 feet RMSE according to ASPRS Positional Accuracy Standards for Digital Geospatial Data. Resultant orthoimagery was rectified to a DEM surface created from existing LiDAR data acquired in 2020. Orthoimagery was delivered in 2,500’ x 2,500’ GeoTiff and MrSID tiles, Township, Municipal and County Wide MrSID mosaics. 3-inch and 6-inch resolution images are available for download from GeoData@Wisconsin - once downloaded, the resolution can be determined for individual tiles.
